setupNeeded.instructions: These providers have no subscription profile, so they are ranked as if their quota were unlimited and every model were included in the plan. Without holding up the current task (this recommendation works without them), ask the user these questions, for every provider at once, and save each answer with set_subscription: plan and purpose in the user's words; quota (generous, standard or tight); quotaWindow (5h, weekly or monthly), how often its limit resets; quotaPool, the same name on every provider that shares one quota; includedFamilies or paidFamilies when some models are billed apart from the plan; and, if the purpose narrows it, role (primary, secondary, experimental or lastResort), onlyFamilies or avoidFamilies and onlyTaskTypes. Families come from each provider's `families`. A cheap plan kept to try models the other subscriptions lack is quota tight and role experimental. If the user would rather not say, save plan "not given" and quota standard, so they are not asked again.

# t3-autopilot subscription profiles, one per provider instance id.
# Written by the set_subscription tool; you can also edit it by hand.
# Keys: plan, quota (generous | standard | tight), purpose, role
# (primary | secondary | experimental | lastResort), quotaPool, quotaWindow
# (5h | weekly | monthly),
# includedFamilies or paidFamilies, onlyFamilies or avoidFamilies,
# onlyTaskTypes. See docs/reference.md#subscription-profiles:
# https://github.com/pablosalme/t3-autopilot/blob/main/docs/reference.md#subscription-profiles

version: 1
subscriptions:
  claudeAgent:
    plan: Claude Max
    quota: generous
    role: primary
    updatedAt: 2026-11-21T09:00:00.000Z
  cursor:
    plan: X Subscription Premium ($30), includes Cursor Pro
    quota: standard
    quotaPool: x-premium
    quotaWindow: weekly
    includedFamilies:
